{{Top|leg}}
'''Shakwulfs''' were a type of domesticated animal used by [[Farm/Legends|farmers]]. They had spines on their backs, and at birth they were blind. [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|One such farmer]] used a shakwulf named [[Brun (shakwulf)|Brun]] to herd [[Whellay/Legends|whellays]] on [[Okator VIII]].
